listing.title: My First Fairy Tale Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Magical Things – Castle, Dragon, Unicorn, Princess & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly fairy-tale things!

Little hands color 30 magical pages, from a castle, a dragon and a unicorn to a princess, a frog prince and a pumpkin coach. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, most with happy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Castles and royal things: Castle, Tower, Crown, Throne and Shield
  • Fairy-tale friends: Princess, Prince, Knight, Fairy, Frog Prince, Gnome, Mermaid and Wolf
  • Magical creatures: Dragon, Baby Dragon, Unicorn and Pegasus
  • Storybook things: Pumpkin Coach, Glass Slipper, Beanstalk and Magic Beans
  • Magic things: Magic Wand, Magic Lamp, Flying Carpet, Crystal Ball, Potion, Spell Book, Wizard Hat, Mushroom House and Wishing Well
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
